slides.title: Four workstyles. No right or wrong.
slides.headline: Four workstyles. No right or wrong.
notes: This is the cohesive exercise for the day. The aim is to work well with each style, not to label anyone.
Allow about 25 minutes for both slides.

slides.title: What is your workstyle?
slides.headline: What is your workstyle?
notes: Print one worksheet per leader: Shannon’s Professional Workstyles worksheet, stored in coaching-references downloads.
Each leader fills in Team Member, Workstyle and Work With Me By.
Then talk about how to work well with each style. Keep it light. There is no right or wrong style.
slides.support: Complete the Professional Workstyles worksheet. In each set of four words, pick the one that fits how you are at work.
body: Count your a, b, c and d answers. Your highest total is your style.
Share your style, then how others get the best from you.
Write it under Work With Me By.
